title: Sing Diilangi dening Tes Banyu
intro: Ing sejarah kitab suci kuna, ana tokoh sing nggumunake sing critane ora diwiwiti saka mukjizat dramatis utawa wahyu sing gedhe banget, nanging kanthi pacoban iman sing prasaja nanging jero. Sawijining bangsa ngadeg ing persimpangan dalan, nggoleki tuntunan ilahi kanggo kepemimpinan. Sing kedadeyan yaiku pacoban sing cerdas banget nganti bisa mbukak sapa wae sing percaya sejati ing antarane. Apa sampeyan bisa ngungkap misteri iki saka petunjuk sing ditinggalake?
clues: Aku asale saka garis keturunan sing dikagumi wong-wong, lan Allah milih aku kanggo tujuan suci sing ora bisa dingerteni wong-wong.
Awakku nduweni ciri khas sing ora diduweni wong liya, sing ndadekake aku beda karo wong-wong liya.
Nalika kali kasebut dinyatakake minangka ujian, umume wong padha mundur—nanging aku terus maju, didorong dening iman sing ora goyah marang janjine Allah.
Aku diprentahake supaya ora ngombe saka banyu sing dilarang, nanging ana tetes sing metu saka lambeku—dosa sing ngganggu atiku salawas-lawase.
Gusti Allah wis takdirake aku ketemu karo pangon enom sing mbesuke bakal dadi legenda amarga bisa mateni mungsuh sing gagah prakosa.
Nalika tentara-tentara bentrok, aku ora tiba ing tangan mungsuh, nanging miturut prentahe Gusti Allah minangka paukuman amarga pembangkanganku ing kali.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
